def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Implement Toolformer loss-filter: keep calls where margin >= tau_filter.

    Parameters
    ----------
    logp_with_result : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        Log probabilities after API call with result.
    logp_call_only : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        Log probabilities after API call without result.
    logp_no_call : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        Log probabilities without any API call.
    tau_filter : float
        Nonnegative filtering threshold.

    Returns
    -------
    keep_mask : np.ndarray of bool, shape (n_candidates,)
        True if margin[m] >= tau_filter.
    margin : np.ndarray of float, shape (n_candidates,)
        Finite margin = min(L_no_call, L_call_only) - L_with_result.
    """
    # ---------- input validation ----------
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
        (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
        (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    if not (
        logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape
    ):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    tau_filter = float(tau_filter)
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # ---------- core computation ----------
    _, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    def compute_loss(logp: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """T02: Weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log prob)."""
        return -np.sum(norm_weights * logp, axis=1)

    loss_with_result = compute_loss(logp_with_result)
    loss_call_only = compute_loss(logp_call_only)
    loss_no_call = compute_loss(logp_no_call)

    # T03: Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # T04: Margin-based filtering
    margin = L_minus - loss_with_result
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margin
